facts.business: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited is a pharmaceutical company engaged in manufacturing and delivering pharmaceutical products globally.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter – Search and Seizure: The auditor draws attention to a search and seizure operation carried out by the Income Tax Department during the financial year ended 31 March 2025 at certain offices and manufacturing units of the Company and its subsidiaries, and the residences of selected key managerial personnel. The Company has received a show cause notice under section 158BC of the Tax Act and is in the process of submitting its response. The impact of this matter on the standalone financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2026 and the adjustments (if any) required, is presently not ascertainable. The opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.

key_risks: Ongoing search and seizure proceedings by the Income Tax Department and the resultant show cause notice under section 158BC of the Income Tax Act, 1961, the impact of which on the financial statements is presently not ascertainable.
